Questions business owners ask

I’m not technical. Can I still use this?

Yes. We build and set up everything. You get a simple way to see what’s happening and change things when you want to.

Will AI replace my team?

No. It handles repetitive tasks so your team spends time on customers, sales and decisions that need a person.

What if the AI gets something wrong?

We set clear limits on what it can say and do, and add a handover to a person for anything uncertain. We also review its replies and tune them.

Is my customer data safe?

We use secure connections and give access only to what each step needs. Your data stays in your accounts, and we explain where it goes.

Can it reply in Hindi and English?

Yes. It can reply in the languages your customers use, and we test the replies before going live.

Do I have to change the tools I use?

Usually not. We connect to what you already use, like WhatsApp, Google Sheets, email and your CRM.

How long does it take to set up?

A single workflow can often be set up in a short time. Larger systems take longer. You get a timeline after we map your process.

How much does it cost?

It depends on what we automate and which tools are involved. After a short call, you get a written quote.
